newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal's Banco Sotto up 10 pct on result.
newsitem.headline: Portugal's Banco Sotto up 10 pct on result.

text.p: Shares in Banco Pinto & Sotto Mayor (BPSM) soared on Friday to hit a high of 2,348 escudos, more than 10 percent up on Thursday's close, after it announced first half profit nearly doubled to 8.4 billion escudos.
The stock then retreated from the record high to trade at 2,260 at 0924 GMT, still 6.4 percent up on the previous close in heavy trade of over 400,000 shares.
Traders said that although there had been talk in the market of a profit figure around 8.5 billion escudos, the confirmation had clearly given the stock new impetus.
The next price target could be 2,400 escudos, some traders said, although the share could come in for some more profit-taking first after its initial big leap.

"Sotto did very well in the first half and although it was in line with market expectations, the feeling is growing that it is more and more the star of the (Champalimaud) group," said one sector analyst who asked not to be named.

Some analysts said that following the first half figures, the could be some upward revision in the outlook for the full year. "Sotto is worth 2,500 escudos (per share) and it could reach that level," said another analyst. ($1=186 escudos)
